text:
Predicates:
WorkInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
FromCS(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
HasPartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakeDatabase(x) ::: x takes the database course.
InstructedByDavid(x) ::: x is instructed by professor David.
WorkInLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Premises:
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ WorkInLibrary(x)) → ¬FromCS(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ HasPartTimeJob(x)) → WorkInLibrary(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ TakeDatabase(x)) → FromCS(x)) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ InstructedByDavid(x)) → TakeDatabase(x)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x ((Student(x) ∧ WorkInLab(x)) → InstructedByDavid(x)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
Student(james) ∧ WorkInLab(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
Student(jack) ∧ ¬HasPartTimeJob(jack) ∧ ¬WorkInLab(jack) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Conclusion:
HasPartTimeJob(james) ::: James has a part-time job offered by the university.
